subject: External communication surfaces must share the canonical effect and authority boundary

body.text:
The named estate contains real communication/effect surfaces: BonfyreSync can perform remote PUT via curl; BonfyreTel can send SMS/MMS/place calls; BonfyreWire can ingest/listen with legacy authorization flags. These are valuable Powers, but they must not become escape hatches around the mature effects model.

Converge all outbound real-world communication into the existing EXTERNAL_EFFECT boundary:
EffectIntent/semantic action -> actor/institution identity -> Authority/consent/policy -> PhysicalExecutionFrame/carrier -> effect attempt -> receipt or unknown external outcome -> reconciliation/evidence.

Inbound observations remain EXTERNAL_READ/observations as appropriate and do not automatically authorize a reply. A CLI flag, legacy key, telephone number, Git author, provider identity, or mesh audience is not semantic authority. Current Run8 generic external writes policy is closed; preserve it. Do not send any SMS/call/remote Sync request as part of this proof.

Required local/no-op proof: the same unauthorized outbound intent is denied before carrier execution whether addressed through Tel, Sync or a shell semantic operator, and the denial has one canonical reason/evidence path. A permitted synthetic/local effect can prove receipt plumbing without touching an external party.
